votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of August 27, 2024; September 3, 2024; September 10, 2024; September 17, 2024; and October 8, 2024.
votes.description: The Council approved the minutes from five prior work session meetings. This is a routine administrative action to officially record prior proceedings.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 46 of 2024 recognizing City Attorney Katherine Lewis for her contributions to Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council adopted a joint ceremonial resolution with the Mayor honoring outgoing City Attorney Katherine Lewis for her service and dedication to Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 91 of 2024 amending Titles 2, 5, 18, and 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to update building code references, modify enforcement appeal process, and add/increase building enforcement fines and penalties.
votes.description: The ordinance brings the City's building regulations into compliance with state law by updating references to state adopted code, modifying the building code enforcement appeal process, and aligning fines and penalties with zoning enforcement standards.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 93 of 2024 amending the Fiscal Year 2025 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for specified items, and adopt a legislative intent statement requesting a written report evaluating the City Prosecutor's Office structure and operations.
votes.description: The Council approved Budget Amendment No. 2 for FY2024-25, covering fleet vehicles, police staffing grants, downtown revitalization zone sales tax, and numerous other capital and grant items, while also requesting an administrative review of the City Prosecutor's Office operational models.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 92 of 2024 establishing the Jordan River Fairpark zoning district and rezoning approximately 93 acres at approximately 1500 W North Temple to the JRF zoning district, request the administration enter into a development agreement with the applicant, and request an annual audit/review of the project area.
votes.description: The Council created a new Jordan River Fairpark zoning district allowing buildings up to 400 feet tall to support redevelopment of approximately 93 acres near the Fairpark area, and directed the administration to finalize a development agreement with Larry H. Miller Development and provide annual public reporting on costs and revenues.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 94 of 2024 approving a $350,000 loan for Frontier Fruit, LLC from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: The Council approved a $350,000 EDLF loan to Frontier Fruit, LLC, a taproom at 1388 South 300 West, to support the creation of 19 new jobs and retention of 11 existing jobs.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 47 of 2024 authorizing the Administration to enter into an interlocal agreement with the Utah Fairpark Area Investment and Restoration District to provide municipal services to the Fairpark District Boundary.
votes.description: The Council authorized an interlocal agreement requiring the Fairpark District to reimburse Salt Lake City for municipal services including water, sewer, police, fire, and homelessness assistance provided within the district boundary, as required by state law by December 31, 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 44 of 2024 requesting Salt Lake City's participation in the Municipal Alternative Voting Methods Pilot Project to use ranked choice voting for the 2025 municipal election.
votes.description: The Council approved participation in the state-authorized ranked choice voting pilot program for the 2025 municipal election, in which voters rank candidates by preference and elimination rounds continue until a candidate exceeds 50% of votes.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 43 of 2024 confirming the Salt Lake City ADA Self-Evaluation and Transition Plan.
votes.description: The Council approved the City's Americans with Disabilities Act Self-Evaluation and Transition Plan, which assesses City compliance with the ADA and identifies steps to eliminate accessibility barriers in programs, facilities, and public spaces.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 45 of 2024 amending the Council Policy regarding Travel, Training, and Capacity Building.
votes.description: The Council updated its internal policy manual to revise the section governing council member travel, training, and capacity building activities.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent agenda including Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 2) for Fiscal Year 2024-25 and the appointment of Nate King to the Art Design Board.
votes.description: The Council approved a batch of grant holding account items for FY2024-25 and confirmed the appointment of Nate King to the Art Design Board for a term ending December 10, 2027.
